items.text: New trade idea: Christian McCaffrey for Dak Prescott + Trey McBride
New waiver claim to make: Seahawks D/ST

take: You're in (98.7%) but the bye isn't safe yet (19.1%). Regular season wins still matter a lot.
You win it all in 23.9% of sims. Your biggest threat is Tyler's Talented Team at 30.4%.
Best trade they'd likely accept (41% yes): Christian McCaffrey for Dak Prescott + Trey McBride with Tyler's Talented Team. Title odds +8.5.
Backup plan: Saquon Barkley for Dak Prescott (Tyler's Talented Team), +6.3.

Swing big if they bite: Luther Burden III + Christian McCaffrey for CeeDee Lamb + George Pickens (Andrew's Awesome Team) is worth +10.8, but it hurts their lineup so expect a no unless they're desperate.
Biggest risk: Trevor Lawrence getting hurt costs you 17.3% in title odds. Make sure you have a real backup there.
Waivers: Seahawks D/ST (D) for Commanders D/ST adds about +1.4 pts a week to your lineup.
